review: SAME_AGENT_CHALLENGE; no independent reviewers in this iteration
scope: Requested website animations, preserving approved composition, page sections, offer, prices, assets and metadata

before.marketing: Publicity tabs updated content instantly; old motion selectors targeted retired ms-* elements. Actual styles showed no transition on purchase-explanation or purchase-example; orbit glow ran indefinitely.
before.home: Manual views and one-time ad entrances existed. Keep manual control; consolidate the view transition under the shared owner.
before.other_pages: Shared experience-motion was not connected to Software, Precios, Hablemos or Login.
before.cascading: directory-c-shared disabled experience-item/reveal transformations and animation, and main.js retained an obsolete hidden reveal owner.

priorities.decision: REFINAR existing tabs; keep native selection and focus owners
priorities.purpose: Orientation and immediate feedback when comparing channels or Home views
priorities.evidence: Current documentation refreshed; prior live example observed at 1440 and 390 with selection and moving indicator. No copied source or assets.
priorities.adaptation: Moving underline, rather than moving dark fill: labels retain contrast throughout transit. Home manual opacity transition; Marketing selected copy/work/image change briefly, keeping dimensions and current data.
priorities.contract: Manual click/Arrow/Home/End -> selected state immediately -> 240ms transition -> stable. No autoplay. Resize recomputes underline without motion. Image transition waits for its current load.
priorities.acceptance: Correct selected/labelledby/tabIndex, final selected image, no stale queues, no overflow or hero height jump.
priorities.observed: Marketing Meta/Google/TikTok switched with keyboard and mouse; selected image CSS animation observed. Home indicator and keyboard selection observed; hero height 665.765625px unchanged across views at 1440. Home view fade controller verified with unit tests; a post-click DOM sample captured its stable final state.

priorities.decision: REFINAR native examples and FAQ details
priorities.purpose: Preserve context during optional-detail opening and closing
priorities.evidence: Primary documentation refreshed for details-content, interpolate-size and discrete content-visibility transitions.
priorities.adaptation: 240ms intrinsic-height transition in supporting browsers. Native open state, summary, keyboard and search semantics remain intact. Existing label/default scripts retain control. No animation during initial default selection. Older browsers retain native instantaneous height and receive a 180ms opening fade when JS is available.
priorities.acceptance: No fixed content caps, preserved defaults/choices on resize, native Enter activation and focus, all content readable.
priorities.observed: Mobile Meta example opened by Enter; intermediate content block 3.85938px -> final295.016px, summary remained focused. Google/Meta/TikTok state true/true/false persisted after resizing to1440. Hablemos FAQ fifth opened by Enter and native name exclusivity closed the first.

priorities.decision: REFINAR one-time introductions and CTA feedback on six pages
priorities.purpose: Orient reading on section entry and acknowledge available actions
priorities.adaptation: Visible base HTML; 400ms one-time entrance, 300ms on mobile. No pending hidden classes. CTA arrow moves3px over160ms on keyboard focus or fine-pointer hover; disabled controls excluded. No moving prices/KPI, scroll lock, trackers or animation library.
priorities.acceptance: Content remains available if shared JS fails or arrives late. Finish transient classes on focus, reduced-motion preference change or backgrounding; no entrance replay.
priorities.observed: Actual site-motion-enter computed animations observed on Marketing and Software. One shared script owner on all six pages. Normal-state headings and reveal content visible at all tested widths.

validation.responsive: Six active pages at configured viewport1440,1920,390,360,320, after load. 30 records in responsive.json. Browser scrollbar consumes15px of content viewport. No horizontal overflow, completed broken images or hidden non-tabbed headings. Useful content max1440 at1920.
validation.keyboard: Home and Marketing arrows retained focus/selection. Native details Enter. Mobile menu Escape closed it and returned focus.
validation.tests: Seven Node VM regression tests passed: reduced initial state, changing preference during motion, rapid selection, focused controls, one-time entry/background stop, older-browser details fallback, manual Home view event.
validation.reduced_motion: JS branches and interruption verified in controlled VM. CSS reduce rules reviewed. Actual OS preference in a browser remains untested: IAB exposes viewport/visibility, no media emulation.
validation.fallback: Browser fixtures without script tags: all six pages at390 kept headings visible (opacity1), no hidden reveal content and no horizontal overflow. Precios Meta native disclosure opened by Enter with295.016px content. A Marketing fixture delayed the shared script3seconds; its post-navigation loaded state remained visible (opacity0.88 during entrance), overflow0. Navigation waited for the delayed script, so the visual state during that3second wait was not directly sampled. Full slow-network browser throttling remains untested. See fallback.json.
validation.visual: Selected desktop Home/Marketing and mobile Precios renders observed. This is targeted motion verification, not a fresh complete accessibility certification or buyer usability study.
validation.seo: Metadata, noindex and commercial content preserved; no new tracking or invented capabilities.
validation.performance: No new dependencies or images. Browser console inspected without errors. Field Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse and conversion impact not measured.
validation.not_in_scope: Connecting contacts, reservations, login or GISBA. Interactive Software task walkthrough would be a separate illustration change, not implemented in this iteration.

publication: PENDING at creation; see deployment.json after publish
